runtimes.value: llama.cpp llama-server with official GGUF (tencent, arch hy_v3, Q4_K_M 18.2 GB, Q8_0 32 GB; needs build with PR #25395, merged 13.07.2026); Ollama only via hf.co/tencent/Hy-MT2-30B-A3B-GGUF or community maternion/hy-mt2; LM Studio (GGUF, link only); MLX only community builds with a bundled hy_v3.py adapter (QwQbb 4/8-bit, tested on M5 Max 128 GB): stock mlx-lm has no hy_v3 (PR #1211 closed unmerged)
runtimes.note: PR #25395 was written for Hy3; that the Hy-MT2 30B GGUF loads with it is inferred from the shared hy_v3 arch, not from a test report. dawncr0w oQ*-MLX builds (oMLX format) exist; their runtime not checked. vLLM/SGLang/transformers >= 5.6.0 documented for CUDA, not Mac.

web.summary: Larger variant of Hy-MT2-7B, for when the 7B is not good enough.
web.scope: Searched on 13.11.2026: Hacker News comments (Algolia API). Reddit, Hugging Face discussions and runtime issues not read.

comments.text: Technical comment on its 1.25-bit variant; no hands-on report on translation quality ([HN, 48991840](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48991840)).
The authors' paper claims it beats strong open models; no per-language tables in the summaries found (authors' claim, not user feedback) ([arXiv 2605.22064](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.22064)).
